label.purpose: Uppercase metadata, evidence types, and state labels.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Border, color, and tonal changes on interaction.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Respect prefers-reduced-motion without removing state visibility.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action used for scan, refresh, wallet, and recovery actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#ff2ea6; color:#050505; min-height:40px; padding:10px 15px; border:0; border-radius:0; font:800 11px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; transition:background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#ff5cbe; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #67e8f9; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary account or navigation action with no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height:40px; padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid #2a2a2e; border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:#a1a1aa; font:700 10px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color:#ff2ea6; color:#ff2ea6; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #67e8f9; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Research Input
components.description: Dark square input for capital, filters, and account forms.
components.css: .ds-input-label { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#a1a1aa; font:800 11px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-input { min-height:40px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid #2a2a2e; border-radius:0; background:#050505; color:#f4f4f5; font:400 13px/1.5 ui-monospace,monospace; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:#ff2ea6; outline:2px solid #67e8f9; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Signal Chip
components.description: Small explicit state label for read-only, simulated, or semantic status.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:28px; padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid rgba(255,46,166,.45); border-radius:0; background:rgba(255,46,166,.08); color:#ff2ea6; font:800 10px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Research Panel
components.description: Flat bordered surface for workflow, diagnosis, market, and account content.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding:20px; border:1px solid #2a2a2e; border-radius:0; background:#101012; color:#f4f4f5; } .ds-kicker { margin:0 0 8px; color:#ff2ea6; font:800 10px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Full-width application navigation with square active state and mobile scrolling.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:4px; overflow-x:auto; padding:4px; border:1px solid #2a2a2e; border-radius:0; background:#101012; } .ds-nav button { min-height:40px; flex:0 0 auto; padding:9px 14px; border:0; border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:#a1a1aa; font:700 11px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-nav button:hover { background:#17171a; color:#ff2ea6; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { background:#ff2ea6; color:#050505; }

narrative.overview: ARBITRAGE//SCAN is a dark, evidence-first research instrument. It should feel like an active lab notebook translated into a field console: dense enough for comparison, restrained enough that the evidence remains readable, and explicit enough that a visitor can tell simulated, read-only, and negative states apart. The interface is intentionally not a marketing page or a promise of profit. Its visual tension comes from a mostly quiet terminal-black canvas with sparse magenta and cyan signals.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces with borders and tonal layers instead of shadows.
Editorial Magenta marks action and selection.
Risk and simulated states remain explicit.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Magenta is for action and selection; cyan is for measured data. Do not use either as general decoration.

rules.name: The Evidence Boundary Rule
rules.body: Simulated data, read-only research, warnings, and negative outcomes must retain explicit text labels in addition to color.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Do not add ambient shadows, glass blur, or floating-card effects to ordinary panels. Use a border or tonal shift first.

rules.name: The Instrument Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels identify a section or state; they do not replace explanatory copy.

dos: Do make evidence type and risk state visible in text.
Do preserve square geometry, thin borders, and flat tonal layering.
Do keep mobile controls touch-safe and navigation single-line scrollable.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, ambient shadows, glassmorphism, or decorative blur as default surface treatment.
Don't use pink or cyan as generic decoration or status substitutes.
Don't present simulated values or read-only quotes as confirmed profit or completed transactions.
